lines.text: 2.6Lifestyleof People
a. In Mountainous Valleys of Pakistan
Densityof population is low inmountainous
regions due to climatic conditions and non
availability of manyfacilities of life.
Some of the people of mountainous region go
to lowland areas during winter season. This
practice is termed as trans-humance.
Crops such as wheat, maize, potato, peas,
barley and millet are cultivated on hill
terraces.
Fruit such as apricot, peaches, plum, cherry,
apple and dry fruit plants are also grown in
valleys of these mountains.
In accordance with the availability of water
limited agriculture and settled lifestyle is
practiced.
In winter people are bound to stay at homes
and adopt indoor activities e.g. carpet
making.
Seasonal earning comes from tourism.
Sheep and goat rearing is common practice.

b.InPlateausof Pakistan
iBalochistanPlateau
Rearing of goat and sheep is a major occupation.
Agricultureis practiced throughKarez irrigation.
Western winds bring rain in winter and grapes are cultivated near Quetta.
Marinefishing is done in coastalareas.
Gwadar port has a great potential for domestic as well as international trade.
Road transport available only to main towns / air transport is even more limited.
Density of population is very less due to rugged terrain.
